review.description: Required final verification now includes isolated API response measurements after heavy suites while keeping the existing glossary/UI/flow ownership, historical adoption and separate reconciliation/local-CI obligations.
review.implementation: Make runs the strict100ms isolated API gate across five packages with -p1, transitive through test-performance without altering fixture-sensitive verify prerequisite lists. Hosted CI retains six outcome-specific API timing artifacts. Final reconciliation still uses CLI-written fingerprints and separate make ci; no agent/model credentials run in CI. Cycle2F5 synchronizes timing.PHASES API command identity with the actual five-package serial Make command; execution and recorded evidence retain exactly the same-p1scope.
review.tests: Read VerificationGraphTests requiring one ordered API-performance invocation after heavy tooling and before UI performance/package. New package fixtures measure normal successful responses, accepted pending work, bounded rejection and first real SSE acknowledgement separately;100ms gate and fixture-only enforcement remain mandatory. Exact fake-command dispatch and the ordered once-only assertion both require -p 1 and all five API packages. The complete focused suites passed: 50 CI graph/entrypoint, 51 timing, 118 local-verification and 10 strict-gate tests. Read the full52-case timing fixture result and new test_api_phase_records_exact_make_command_and_serial_package_scope, which extracts actual Make argv, checks timing phase identity and asserts the successful emitted journal row. Static both CI fake-command literals also match; unchanged prerequisite lists remain intact.
